# Official 3MF sample fixtures

The `.3mf` files in this directory are unmodified copies from the 3MF
Consortium's samples repository
(<https://github.com/3MFConsortium/3mf-samples>, `examples/core`),
redistributed under the BSD 2-Clause license reproduced in
`LICENSE-3mf-samples.txt`. They serve as ground truth that this
crate's mesh loader turns real, consortium-published packages into
scenes rather than home-grown approximations of the specification.
